description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.10 each) capped at 19999, [Imperil Holy 20% (25s)], grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Highborn Mode I (FuSoYa v2)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Highborn Mode I (FuSoYa v2)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for equipped Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Highborn Mode II (FuSoYa v2)], removes [Dual Awoken Highborn Mode I (FuSoYa v2)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Highborn Mode II (FuSoYa v2)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for equipped Holy abilities, doublecasts Holy Abilities and casts Moonflower Mystery after using Holy Abilities

description.name: Moonflower Mystery
description.text: Four single attacks (3.20 each) and grants [Holy +30% Boost 1] to all allies

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
